potential_unspecified_behavior: Unscoped intelligence events (vision_describe.*, and possibly others that do not set data['drive']) are now delivered to every connected viewer when CORE_INTERNAL_SECRET is set. Before this change they were presumably dropped with a 403.
regression_risks: Before this change, events from refine, summaries, vision, chapter_suggestions and video_visual were rejected with a 403 in production. They are now broadcast, so frontend handlers that were never exercised in production will start firing.
